opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with the Trust contributing salary costs and up to £6,000 per year in research expenses.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research over 2-3 years, funding replacement salary costs.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities that hold research degree awarding powers in their own right; consortia of up to two universities allowed.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area, including additional studentships, postdoctoral opportunities and programme administration costs.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education (and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations).
opportunities.summary: For researchers to undertake an innovative and original research project of up to 5 years. The outline stage is paused; detailed applications are being accepted from invited applicants.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions (universities with research degree awarding powers, and some specialist arts institutions) inviting an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; collaborative centres encouraged.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary round opens February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars at UK universities with research degree awarding powers, at an early stage of their academic career.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The Centenary round opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research over 3-24 months. Application materials available from September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university or eligible research organisation, living in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication over 3-24 months. Application materials available from September 2026.
